per_item.label: amounts rounded half-up to cents
hits: Amounts are rounded to cents with half-up rounding (Math.round), which runs on floating-point values.

per_item.label: repeated txn id with a different payload is acknowledged and ignored
hits: A repeated transaction id returns success and does nothing, without checking that the account, amount or operation type match the original.
A retry gets a plain ok, the same reply as a new operation, so the caller cannot tell it was a duplicate.
The amount is validated before the duplicate check, so a retry of an accepted id with a bad amount is rejected instead of acknowledged.
